title: Uniform constructible bounds for finite scalar tensor levels
statement: Let E and L be finite extensions of Q_l with an embedding E -> L and Y any scheme. Use the completed coefficient sheaves and scalar tensor complexes of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Let P be a K-flat complex of completed O_E-module sheaves with flat terms, the good class of [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. Fix integers r <= s. Suppose the derived residue reduction Q(P) tensor^L k_E is bounded constructible [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] and has cohomological support contained in [r,s] [def-weil-cohomological-support]. Then for every n >= 0 the finite target scalar tensor complex P tensor (O_L/pi_L^(n+1)) has bounded constructible cohomology over that quotient, and its cohomological support is contained in the same [r,s]. No completeness of P or higher source reduction hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use the explicit target power-ideal filtration and integralScalarResidueLayers_bounds. Its successive layer tensors have constructible homology and vanish outside [r,s]; the filtration is antitone, begins at the whole quotient module, and ends at zero.
Apply filteredCoefficientTensor_constructible_bounds to this filtration. The flat-term hypothesis is exactly P.property.2. Take the theorem's conclusion for the whole regular coefficient module.

Use integralScalarRegularTensorComparison to transfer constructibility and vanishing to derived cohomology of integralScalarFiniteComplex. Nonvanishing degrees must lie in [r,s], by contradiction with vanishing outside this interval. Their set is finite since it is a subset of the finite integer interval. This proves intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible and precisely the requested support bound.

lean.statement:
theorem integralScalarFiniteLevel_bounds
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (r s : ℤ) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (h₁ : intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E 1 (by omega) Y
      ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl 0).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)))
    (hbound : ∀ i : ℤ,
      i ∈ proEtaleCohomologicalSupport
        ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl 0).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) →
      r ≤ i ∧ i ≤ s) :
    ∀ n : ℕ,
      intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l L (n + 1)
        (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)) Y
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((integralScalarFiniteComplex l E L ι Y n).obj P.obj)) ∧
      ∀ i : ℤ,
        i ∈ proEtaleCohomologicalSupport
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((integralScalarFiniteComplex l E L ι Y n).obj P.obj)) →
        r ≤ i ∧ i ≤ s
